svg.title: Fig. 83(e) — The evolute of the astroid is an astroid twice as large
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 83(e), page 89. Section: evolutes.

g.data-text: The astroid (heavy) with its cusps on the axes at distance a, the circles of radii a/2 and a about O, and the two axes.
Draw the diagonals through O: the evolute's cusps will lie on them.
The evolute is an astroid twice as large, turned through 45°: its cusps are on the diagonals, on the circle of radius 2a (σ = (3a/2) sin 2t).
